title: perf: serialize() memoizes atomic values (str/int/None) for cycle detection
author: devin-ai-integration[bot]
body_preview: ### Problem Statement  `_Serializer._serialize_node()` wraps every node in `with self.memo.memoize(obj)`, including `str`, `int`, `float`, `bool` and `None`. These can't contain references, so they can never form a cycle, but they make up most of the nodes in an error event (stack frame fields, context lines, frame vars).
